desktop.note: Reviewed the five current paired showcase captures at desktop, laptop, tablet, mobile and narrow-mobile, plus all nine current authenticated normal-state matrix screenshots across Chromium, Firefox and WebKit. The candidate retains the charcoal background, vivid pink palette, central Flopstyle insignia, outlined title treatment and module hierarchy; at mobile and narrow-mobile the mark, rating blocks and headings remain contained. The JP shell and translated page content differ from the upstream showcase, so the review remains a warning.
